# Zoho Analytics REST API - OKF bundles

> Version index for the Zoho Analytics REST API Open Knowledge Format bundles. Each API version ships as a self-contained OKF v0.2 bundle in its own top-level directory of this repository. Start with the version you need; every version has its own llms.txt carrying the full link list for that version.

## Available versions

- [V2 (current, stable)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/llms.txt): 168 endpoints across 10 domains and 33 groups, 278 error codes, 31 OAuth scopes, 8 workflow playbooks. Base URL https://analyticsapi.zoho.com, path prefix /restapi/v2, OAuth 2.0 with the Zoho-oauthtoken scheme.

## Quick links (V2)

- [Bundle index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/index.md): the full table of contents.
- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/overview.md): what the API is, the object model, and the five conventions every call shares.
- [How to use this bundle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/how-to-use-this-bundle.md): directory layout, the api frontmatter contract, navigation rules for agents and generators.
- [Endpoint catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/endpoint-catalog.md): all 168 endpoints with method, path, operation ID, group, scope and success status.
- [Endpoint catalog (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/references/endpoint-catalog.json): every endpoint, machine-readable.
- [Bundle manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/v2/manifest.json): bundle version, OKF version, counts and entry points.

## Machine-readable version index

- [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-okf/main/manifest.json): every available version with its status, path and bundle manifest. Read this instead of hard-coding a version directory.

## Optional

- V3 is not published yet. When it is, it will appear under /v3/ and as an additional entry in the root manifest.json. Nothing under /v2/ will move.
